records.finding: The SeverityThreshold doc comment's worked example was ~100x wrong: '$2M/hour ≈ 33333 minor/min at exponent 2' conflated dollars/min with minor/min and telescoped $2M/hour down to $333/min. Misleads the registry author choosing floors.
records.evidence: $2M/hour at exponent 2 is 200,000,000 minor/hour = 3,333,333 minor/min, not ~33333.
records.reason: Rewrote the example with correct arithmetic: a flow losing $2M/hour is 200,000,000 minor/hour / 60 ≈ 3,333,333 minor/min at exponent 2 (USD cents).

records.finding: The sev-name validation (empty || >32 || whitespace/control) had only the empty branch tested; the >32-length and whitespace branches were unexercised. Also a SuggestSeverity case duplicated 'exactly the floor', leaving 'rate strictly above the top floor' untested.
records.evidence: Only {empty sev} negative case; two identical USD 1_000_000 cases.
records.reason: Added negative cases for a whitespace sev, a >32-char sev, and an unknown field inside a severity entry (KnownFields). Replaced the duplicate SuggestSeverity case with a rate well above the top floor (still SEV1).
